faqs.q: Does API request converter (cURL ↔ fetch ↔ axios) upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. API request converter (cURL ↔ fetch ↔ axios) executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/api-builder-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate API request converter (cURL ↔ fetch ↔ axios)?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/api_builder.json or open /tools/api-builder?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
